title: Research: dual-scale Norm exists for every odd-prime-power precision-blind pair (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Answers open question 1 of just-open [#4063](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4063): does every odd prime-power precision-blind `a=(1+p^{w-1},1)` on `(Z/p^w Z)^2` admit dual-scale Norm on the same two coordinates `(H'_1,D'_0)` into some reciprocal unit pair `(u,u^{-1})`?

**Yes**, with closed form `u=a0`:

- Dual scales `(s_{H1},s_{D0})=(a0^{-1},a0)` realize `F_{(a0,a0^{-1})}` with `(P')²=I`, so Theorem 1 of `weighted-wrapper-contract` makes two equal ordinary calls equal interchange `J` on all of `G×G`.
- No shared single-factor scale exists for any odd `p` and `w≥2` (`s²≡1` forces `s≡±1`, but `a0≢±1`).
- `a0` is **always** a unit quadratic residue mod `p^w` (`a0≡1 (mod p)`); dual-scale existence uses **invertibility**, not an explicit square root.

Algebraic for all odd `p`, `w≥2`. Certificate grid corroborates 15 pairs (`p∈{3,…,23}`, `w∈{2,…,5}`, `p^w≤2000`), with `#4063` cross-check `(3,2)→(7,4)`. Bank identity is exhaustive only for `(3,2)`; larger pairs use the closed form plus a lattice spot-check. **No Boolean meter inventory. No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

Closest prior: [#4063](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4063) (only `(3,2)` dual `(7,4)` + meters); [#4053](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4053); [#2950](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2950). Soft overlap vs #4063 ≈0.20–0.51 (not a meter retarget).

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/precision-blind-dual-scale-existence/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/precision-blind-dual-scale-existence/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/precision-blind-dual-scale-existence/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/precision-blind-dual-scale-existence/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/precision-blind-dual-scale-existence
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_PRECISION_BLIND_DUAL_SCALE_EXISTENCE pairs=15 primes=[3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23] widths=[2, 3, 4, 5] single_factor=0 square=always dual_scales=inv crosscheck_4063=(7,4) boolean_meters=false no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_PRECISION_BLIND_DUAL_SCALE_EXISTENCE pairs=15 single_factor=0 square=always dual_scales=inv crosscheck_4063=(7,4) boolean_meters=false no_new_kappa
PASS_PRECISION_BLIND_DUAL_SCALE_EXISTENCE_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/precision-blind-dual-scale-existence outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Open next questions / limitations

1. Does the same dual-scale reciprocal construction extend to precision-blind lists of length `n>2` with middle coordinates forced to `±1`?
2. A fully charged Boolean inventory for a further `(p,w)` would need a new closed form or fixture obligation — leave-alone policy blocks thin meter retargets of #4063/#4053.
